title: Finite-free scalar arrows and normalized strict-limit comparison data
statement: On a small ringed site, use ordinary scalar extension and its pure sections [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-section-calculus, def-sfb-scalar-inverse-image-normalization]. A finite-free scalar arrow R to S is a ring-sheaf map whose restricted unit module is isomorphic to a finite product of copies of the R-unit module. For an exact additive functor F between abelian categories with countable products, tower limits and derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], ScalarStrictLimitComparison records a derived natural comparison iso, its ordinary-limit normalization, a projection-normalized product comparison intertwining one minus the transition shift, and the natural signed Roos cone iso with both coordinate formulas and its localization equation [def-weil-strict-roos-model, def-sbc-strict-projection-tower-data]. exactDerived, exactDerivedComp and exactDerivedUnit are the existing exact derived functor and its localized ordinary composition and identity isomorphisms. These definitions are extracted verbatim from the strict-limit theorem interface.
